Me interesan las clases privadas de kitesurfing en Mayapo. Mis fechas de viaje son: ____. ¿Podrían confirmar disponibilidad?" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Check Availability" data-no-translate="true" aria-haspopup="dialog">Check Availability</a></div><div class="faq-list"><details open=""><summary>Is this course suitable for complete beginners?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Yes. No previous kitesurfing experience is required. Your instructor adapts the session to your starting level and progression.</p></details><details><summary>What is included in the course?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Every course includes an IKO-certified instructor, kitesurfing equipment during lessons, IKO certification, photos and lesson video, and walkie-talkie radio coaching.</p></details><details><summary>Is the instruction private?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Choose a private course for 1 student with 1 instructor, or a group course for exactly 2 students with 1 instructor and 1 shared equipment set. The group rate is COP 175,000 per hour per person.</p></details><details><summary>How much are group kitesurfing lessons?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>A group course costs COP 175,000 per hour per person and is designed for 2 students with 1 instructor and 1 shared equipment set. Send both students&#x27; travel dates so we can confirm availability.</p></details><details><summary>How many students do you accept per day?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>We intentionally keep daily capacity and group formats limited so each student receives attentive coaching. Availability depends on safe wind and weather conditions.</p></details><details><summary>How much do I pay to reserve?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>A 30% deposit confirms your reservation. The remaining balance is paid at the end of the course.</p></details><details><summary>Can I pay by debit or credit card?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Yes. We send a secure payment link for debit or credit card payments after confirming your dates, with no additional fee.</p></details><details><summary>What happens if there is not enough wind?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>We first adjust the schedule when possible. If KiteAdventure cancels eligible undelivered lesson time because conditions remain unsuitable, our weather policy applies.</p></details><details class="faq-more"><summary>VIEW 10 MORE QUESTIONS<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><div class="faq-more-list"><details><summary>What happens in adverse weather conditions?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Safety comes first. Sessions may be postponed or cancelled, and eligible school-cancelled lesson time is protected under our weather and refund policy.</p></details><details><summary>How many days should I stay in Mayapo?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Plan 1–2 days for the 4-hour course, 3–4 days for the 8-hour course and 4–5 days for the 12-hour course. An extra weather-flex day is recommended when possible.</p></details><details><summary>What is included in the course-and-stay packages?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Each package includes the stated private course hours, an IKO-certified instructor, equipment during lessons, IKO certification, walkie-talkie radio coaching, private-room accommodation, breakfast, return transportation between Riohacha and Mayapo, course photos and videos, and local assistance. The exact inclusions are confirmed in writing before payment.</p></details><details><summary>Are flights included in the packages?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>No. Flights, unlisted meals, alcoholic drinks, extra nights, companion costs and personal purchases are not included unless they are specifically confirmed in writing.</p></details><details><summary>Which airport should I use for Mayapo?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Use Riohacha&#x27;s Almirante Padilla Airport (RCH). Search Avianca or LATAM from Bogotá, Medellín or Cali. SATENA also operates a direct Barranquilla–Riohacha service on selected days; always verify the current itinerary before purchasing.</p></details><details><summary>What should I bring?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Bring swimwear, a UV-protection shirt, reef-safe sunscreen, a towel, drinking water and comfortable clothes for the beach.</p></details><details><summary>Can you help with accommodation?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Yes. We coordinate accommodation only with Yosu Beach Ecohotel, La Costa House and Talata Hostel. Availability, room category and final conditions are confirmed for your dates.</p></details><details><summary>What is the accommodation price range?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>The accommodation cards above show the indicative nightly ranges for Yosu Beach Ecohotel, Talata Hostel and La Costa House. Final rates vary by room, number of guests, dates and applicable taxes.</p></details><details><summary>Can you help with transportation to Mayapo?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Yes. It has no fixed departure time: the vehicle leaves after enough passengers have joined. Confirm the pickup point and fare before travel.</p></details><details><summary>Where exactly are the lessons?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>KiteAdventure Colombia S.A.S. meets students at the Second Beach of Mayapo, Maliwala sector.
